note: Triennial election of the county council, 1952: nominations 20 May 1952; every seat returned unopposed. The list prints no party labels (so none are given) and has no entry for Crossmore. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed: the first time for many years that Armagh City was not contested. George Leyburn: no party label printed in 1952. At other elections he stood as Unionist (South Ward, Armagh Urban District, 18 May 1949, printed 'Unionist': Armagh Guardian, 6 May 1949, p. 4 ("New City Council: first lady member; two seats go begging"); South-East Ward, Armagh Urban District, 21 May 1952, printed 'Unionists': Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1952, p. 6 ("Armagh"); also the Armagh Guardian, 9 May 1952, p. 1; South Ward, Armagh Urban District, 18 May 1955, printed 'U.': Armagh Guardian, 6 May 1955, p. 1 ("Armagh Council elections: no opposition for Unionists"; "To be returned unopposed")).
